summary: Iteration 8 verified end-to-end: (1) Team invitations — list/create/lookup/accept/revoke, role change/remove guards, RBAC 403 for non-managers, idempotent accept, email-mismatch 403, invalid role 400, duplicate 409. (2) Branded link preview — inserting verified is_primary custom_domain surfaces workspace.primary_domain via /api/auth/me, and both Smart Links and QR pages render 'go.midgate.test/{alias}' instead of '/api/r/{alias}'. (3) Webhook manual retry — failed delivery to httpbin/500 gets 3 attempts, deliveries dialog shows delivery-retry-{id} button, clicking creates a new delivery record. Backend pytest: 11/11 passing. Frontend Playwright: team invite dialog, invite success + copy link, invitations list w/ revoke, developers deliveries dialog + retry, branded URL, invalid /accept-invite token → invite-error — all pass.

issues: webpack-dev-server-client-overlay (about:blank) sometimes intercepts pointer events in preview iframe; removing the element unblocks clicks. Not a product bug but flaky for automated testing.

critical_code_review_comments: team.py list_members lowercases sort by email but backend accepts EmailStr which normalizes case only on create — safe.
invitation accept endpoint enforces email match on user['email'] vs inv['email'] case-insensitively — good.
webhook retry endpoint reuses stored 'data' payload and creates a NEW delivery row (async, non-blocking) — correct.
workspace.list_user_workspaces merges primary_domain from custom_domains where status=verified AND is_primary — correct.
seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up ad-hoc invited users (test_invite_*@example.com, test_mem_*@ex.com) plus a temporary webhook + verified custom_domains doc — all removed after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 fully green. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_team_webhooks_branded.py. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME env vars. Webhook retry test needs ~20s (real httpbin call). For branded-URL UI testing, insert a custom_domains doc {workspace_id, domain, status:'verified', is_primary:true} then GET /api/auth/me and check the Links/QR pages.
